items.title: BBC Three, BBC Scotland and Radio 4 Extra broadcast channels to close
items.summary: The closurse are announced as the corporation continues to try to save £500m over two years.

items.title: Prince Harry says he would like to 'reconcile' with his family
items.summary: Prince Harry has spoken of how he would like to "reconcile" with his family.

items.title: Woman describes alleged assault by Russell Brand as 'frenzied' and 'violent'
items.summary: The entertainer denies three counts of rape, three charges of sexual assault and one of indecent assault.

items.title: BBC announces details of cuts in bid to save £500m
items.summary: The BBC has confirmed the closure of BBC Three, BBC Scotland and BBC Radio 4 Extra linear broadcast services in the spring of 2027.

items.title: UK to deploy jets to defend Saudi Arabia from Houthi attacks
items.summary: The UK announces it will provide additional defensive military support to Saudi Arabia as Houthi attacks escalate in the region.

items.title: Suspect arrested in France after fire at historic city hall
items.summary: A man has been arrested after a fire at the town hall of Limoges, according to French media.
